title: qory.yaml, or harness.yaml
description: qory.yaml, or under its second name harness.yaml: the repository's own document at the checkout root, and the machine's in the user's directory and the checkout's ancestors. Every key is optional, apiVersion too: a file leaving it out is read as qory.dev/v1alpha1.

apiVersion.description: Optional; the newest format this qory reads when left out.

qory.description: The qory versions this document is written for: one or more comparators, such as >=0.3.0 <0.4.0; every one has to be satisfied.

harness.description: The machine's choices for a compose, and in a checkout's file its document: the checkout's own stack, a target and modules, or the stack it extends, the target it composes it for and the modules it appends. A document may leave extends out when qory harness compose -f <stack> selects the base, and a document that extends a stack may list no modules, containing its target and extensions alone.

home.description: Where the harness is composed: .qory/harness in the checkout, or a directory outside it, absolute or under ~, containing one home per checkout.

links.description: What the checkout gets: checkout, links into the home, the default with the home inside the checkout; or none, nothing, the default and the only value with the home outside it.

launch.description: How a runtime's program is started on the home, by runtime name, for qory harness launch: each key set here replaces the runtime's own. ${home} is the home, ${dir} the runtime's directory in it.

args.description: The arguments in groups, such as a flag and its value; a group that refers to a file under ${home} or ${dir} that the compose did not write is left out.

env.description: The variables set for the program.

extends.description: The stack this checkout extends: a directory containing a qory-stack.yaml, or a stack the repository exports, selected by stack. Left out when qory harness compose -f <stack> selects the base.

target.description: The runtime and model the checkout composes for: required for its own stack, and beside extends what it composes the base for, which harness.runtime, harness.model and the flags override. A delivered stack has none.

bind.description: The entry that fills each role a document references: <kind>/<role> to the name of an entry of that kind, so a module writes ${qory:agents/coder} and the stack defines which agent that is.

extensions.description: Values qory copies into the report and does not read: keys of the author's choosing, each a value of any shape.

worktree.description: What a worktree of the repository needs, and where the machine puts it.

exports.description: What this repository publishes for other repositories, by name: each stack at <dir>/stacks/<name>/qory-stack.yaml, each module at <dir>/modules/<name>/qory-module.yaml, dir being the repository root unless set.

dir.description: Where the exports are, relative to the repository root: one directory containing stacks/ and modules/, or a map that defines the stacks and the modules directories' paths as they are.

paths.description: Paths brought into a new worktree: each a path inside the checkout, or {from, to} with from a path anywhere, absolute or under ~, and to the path in the worktree, required when from is outside the checkout.

part.description: A merged part: true for all of it, or the names of some of it.

exclude.description: What of the module the compose leaves out; everything else is composed. Not with only.

only.description: The only things of the module the compose takes; everything not listed is left out. Not with exclude.

link.description: A name at the checkout root that links to the module's directory.

source.description: A directory; a git repository at a ref with the module's directory inside it; or a module the repository exports, selected by module, with path or git and ref defining the repository.

base.description: A directory containing a qory-stack.yaml; a git repository at a ref with that directory inside it; or a stack the repository exports, selected by stack, with path or git and ref defining the repository.

exportName.description: The name of an export, one path segment.
